title: A cycle of
quality in action
intro.text: IQAC strengthens institutional quality through a continuous cycle of building culture, embedding good practice, enabling improvement, and reviewing outcomes.

cycle.title: Build quality culture
cycle.description: Develop quality awareness and shared responsibility across the university.

cycle.title: Embed quality practice
cycle.description: Integrate quality into the university’s everyday academic and administrative work.

cycle.title: Enable improvement
cycle.description: Use relevant processes and evidence to guide institutional improvement.

cycle.title: Review and standardise
cycle.description: Monitor outcomes and review processes to sustain effective standards.

mechanisms.eyebrow: How we put strategy to work
title: Mechanisms for
quality assurance
items: Ensure timely, efficient, and progressive performance across academic, administrative, and financial functions.
Optimise and integrate contemporary approaches to teaching and learning.
Promote relevant, high-quality academic research programmes.
Strengthen the credibility of assessment and evaluation processes.
Support equitable access to, and affordability of, academic programmes.
Ensure adequate maintenance and appropriate allocation of support structures and services.
Share research findings and build networks with institutions in India and abroad.

items.title: Goal 1
items.text: A productive workplace with clear expectations and a commitment to excellence, as well as an ecosystem.

items.title: Goal 2
items.text: Recognizing ability in the context of equity issues for potential students.

items.title: Goal 3
items.text: A learning atmosphere that gives students the best chance of succeeding.

items.title: Goal 4
items.text: Research with high possible impact and the nation’s economic development.

items.title: Goal 6
items.text: High-quality infrastructure to enable teaching-learning, research, and community engagement.

items.title: Goal 7
items.text: Governance and management practices that are in accordance with the mission and values of the university.

items.title: Goal 8
items.text: Sustainable practices for more effective resource usage and improved environmental performance.

items.title: Goal 9
items.text: A growth path to support the university activities.
